<!-- Datatables Default Settings  -->
<script>
    /**
     * Strip HTML from a DataTables cell for PDF/Excel export so raw tags do
     * not leak into the generated document (PSTRAX-3239).
     *
     * - Converts block / break-producing tags to newline so readability survives.
     * - Removes all remaining tags.
     * - Decodes the entities the legacy alert pipeline emits.
     */
    window.pstStripHtmlForExport = function (data) {
        if (data === null || data === undefined) {
            return '';
        }
        if (typeof data !== 'string') {
            return data;
        }
        var stripped = data
            .replace(/<\s*(br|\/p|\/dt|\/dd|\/dl|\/li|\/tr|\/div|\/h[1-6])\s*\/?>/ig, '\n')
            .replace(/<\/?[^>]+>/g, '');
        // Decode the full HTML5 entity table via the DOM so this twin matches
        // PHP `html_entity_decode($value, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8')`
        // (PSTRAX-3239). Tags were already stripped above, so innerHTML can
        // only decode entity refs, not execute markup. If `document` is
        // unavailable (non-browser context), entities remain encoded — that
        // path is intentionally not handled because DataTables exports only
        // run in browsers.
        var decoded = stripped;
        if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
            var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
            ta.innerHTML = stripped;
            decoded = ta.value;
        }
        return decoded
            .replace(/ /g, ' ')
            .replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n')
            .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
            .trim();
    };

    // Pages opt in to the shared stripper by referencing it directly inside their
    // own button exportOptions: `format: {body: window.pstStripHtmlForExport}`.
    // Wiring it onto the global button defaults here would not work — DataTables
    // Buttons resolves per-instance exportOptions via shallow merge, so any page
    // that declares its own exportOptions block fully replaces the defaults.

    $.extend($.fn.dataTable.defaults, {
        dom: '<"tblControls"<B><f><"small"i>>rt<"tblControls grey"lp>',
        paging: true,
        deferRender: true,
        mark: {
            exclude: [".ignore-mark *"],
            separateWordSearch: false
        },
        order: [],
        select: {
            style: 'multi+shift',
            info: true
        },
        language: {
            emptyTable: "No entries in table. Select search options and click the Search/Find button",
            zeroRecords: "No matching entries found.",
            loadingRecords: "Loading - please wait...",
            info: "Showing _TOTAL_ entries",
            infoEmpty: "Showing 0 entries",
            search: "",
            searchPlaceholder: "Search all entries",
            infoFiltered: "<span class='font-weight-bold'>(filtered from _MAX_ total entries)</span>",
            select: {
                rows: {
                    _: "<span class='yellow font-weight-bold'>%d rows selected</span>",
                    0: "<span class='grey-text'>No rows selected</span>",
                    1: "<span class='yellow font-weight-bold'>1 row selected</span>"
                }
            }
        }
    });

    $.fn.dataTable.ext.buttons.clearFilter = {
        text: 'Clear Filters',
        className: 'btn-sm',
        action: function (e, dt, node, config) {
            dt.state.clear();
            window.location.reload();
        }
    };

    $.fn.dataTable.ext.buttons.collection.className += ' btn-sm';

    // PSTRAX-3421: Fix "Export -> Print" crashing the tab with Chrome's
    // RESULT_CODE_KILLED_BAD_MESSAGE. The stock Buttons print action renders into an
    // about:blank popup opened via window.open(''), which a known Chrome/Blink bug kills
    // before the print dialog appears. Render into a hidden same-page iframe instead
    // (the upstream-accepted fix). Data gathering, title, messageTop/Bottom, exportOptions,
    // the customize callback, and autoPrint are all preserved, so per-page configs and
    // Excel/PDF export are unaffected.
    (function () {
        var _printLink = document.createElement('a');

        // Resolve a relative URL to absolute so assets load inside the iframe (no base URL).
        var relToAbs = function (href) {
            _printLink.href = href;
            var linkHost = _printLink.host;
            if (linkHost.indexOf('/') === -1 && _printLink.pathname.indexOf('/') !== 0) {
                linkHost += '/';
            }
            return _printLink.protocol + '//' + linkHost + _printLink.pathname + _printLink.search;
        };

        // Clone a <style>/<link> tag, rewriting <link> hrefs to absolute, for the print head.
        var styleToAbs = function (el) {
            var clone = $(el).clone()[0];
            if (clone.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'link') {
                clone.href = relToAbs(clone.href);
            }
            return clone.outerHTML;
        };

        $.fn.dataTable.ext.buttons.print.action = function (e, dt, button, config) {
            var data = dt.buttons.exportData(
                $.extend({ decodeEntities: false }, config.exportOptions) // XSS protection
            );
            var exportInfo = dt.buttons.exportInfo(config);
            var columnClasses = dt
                .columns(config.exportOptions.columns)
                .flatten()
                .map(function (idx) {
                    return dt.settings()[0].aoColumns[dt.column(idx).index()].sClass;
                })
                .toArray();

            var addRow = function (d, tag) {
                var str = '<tr>';
                for (var i = 0, ien = d.length; i < ien; i++) {
                    // null and undefined aren't useful in the print output
                    var dataOut = d[i] === null || d[i] === undefined ? '' : d[i];
                    var classAttr = columnClasses[i] ? 'class="' + columnClasses[i] + '"' : '';
                    str += '<' + tag + ' ' + classAttr + '>' + dataOut + '</' + tag + '>';
                }
                return str + '</tr>';
            };

            // Construct a table for printing
            var html = '<table class="' + dt.table().node().className + '">';
            if (config.header) {
                html += '<thead>' + addRow(data.header, 'th') + '</thead>';
            }
            html += '<tbody>';
            for (var i = 0, ien = data.body.length; i < ien; i++) {
                html += addRow(data.body[i], 'td');
            }
            html += '</tbody>';
            if (config.footer && data.footer) {
                html += '<tfoot>' + addRow(data.footer, 'th') + '</tfoot>';
            }
            html += '</table>';

            // Copy the title plus the host page's <style>/<link> tags so the print view
            // keeps its base styling.
            var head = '<title>' + exportInfo.title + '</title>';
            $('style, link').each(function () {
                head += styleToAbs(this);
            });

            var body =
                '<h1>' + exportInfo.title + '</h1>' +
                '<div>' + (exportInfo.messageTop || '') + '</div>' +
                html +
                '<div>' + (exportInfo.messageBottom || '') + '</div>';

            // Render into a hidden, offscreen iframe rather than a popup tab.
            var frame = document.createElement('iframe');
            frame.style.position = 'absolute';
            frame.style.border = '0';
            frame.style.width = '0';
            frame.style.height = '0';
            frame.style.left = '-1000000px';
            frame.style.top = '-1000000px';
            document.body.appendChild(frame);

            var win = frame.contentWindow;
            var doc = win.document;
            doc.open();
            doc.write(
                '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head>' + head + '</head>' +
                '<body class="dt-print-view">' + body + '</body></html>'
            );
            doc.close();

            // Make image sources absolute so they resolve inside the iframe.
            $('img', doc.body).each(function (i, img) {
                img.setAttribute('src', relToAbs(img.getAttribute('src')));
            });

            // Preserve the per-page customize contract (win.document.body still applies).
            if (config.customize) {
                config.customize(win, config, dt);
            }

            // Allow stylesheets time to load, then print. A hidden iframe has no visible
            // preview to fall back on, so we always trigger the dialog (per AC#2) rather
            // than honoring autoPrint:false. print() is modal in the target browsers, so
            // the iframe is removed once the dialog returns.
            win.setTimeout(function () {
                win.focus();
                win.print();
                $(frame).remove();
            }, 1000);
        };
    })();


    $.fn.dataTable.Api.register('order.neutral()', function () {
        return this.iterator('table', function (s) {
            s.aaSorting.length = 0;
            s.aiDisplay.sort(function (a, b) {
                return a - b;
            });
            s.aiDisplayMaster.sort(function (a, b) {
                return a - b;
            });
        });
    });
</script>

            $alertIDinput.val(null).prop('required', false);
            $fullSearch.addClass('show');
            $idSearch.removeClass('show');
            $searchModal.modal('show');
            $('#txtstation').val('all').change();
            $('#txtcategory').val('all').change();
        });
        $('#searchIDBtn').on('click', function () {
            $alertIDinput.val(null).focus().prop('required', true);
            $fullSearch.removeClass('show');
            $idSearch.addClass('show');
            $searchModal.modal('show');
        });

        let batchpost = function ($batchUrl, $divClass) {
            let $tblArray = [];
            let hasServiceDueAlert = false;
            // Iterate over all selected rows & create array
            table.rows({selected: true}).every(function (rowIdx, tableLoop, rowLoop) {
                let data = this.data();
                $tblArray.push({
                    id: data.alertid,
                    checklist: data.checklist
                });
                // Check if any selected alert is a Service Due Alert
                if (data.service_due_field_type) {
                    hasServiceDueAlert = true;
                }
            });

            // If any selected alert is a Service Due Alert, show warning and abort
            if (hasServiceDueAlert) {
                toastr.warning('Batch editing is not available for Service Due Alerts. Service Due Alerts require individual handling to update the Next Due field when closing.', '', {
                    timeOut: 8000,
                    extendedTimeOut: 3000
                });
                return;
            }

            //Post the array to the modal page and show the modal
            $.ajax({
                url: $batchUrl,
                type: 'POST',
                data: {"pTableData": JSON.stringify($tblArray)}
            })
                .done(function () {
                    //Add any passed Class, then show modal
                    PSTRAX.$modalContainer.load($batchUrl, function (data) {
                        PSTRAX.$modalContainer.addClass($divClass).modal('show');
                    });
                })
        };

        let resetTbl = function () {
            $('#filterRow input').val('');
            $('#filterRow select').val('');
            table
                .state.clear()
                .search('')
                                .order([[1, "desc"]])
                                .columns().search('')
                .rows().deselect();
        };

        var table = $('#srchResults').DataTable({
            ajax: {
                url: $formURL,
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                data: function (d) {
                    return $srchForm.serialize();
                }
            },
            scrollY: '68vh',
            scrollX: true,
            paging: false,
            scrollCollapse: false,
            columns: [
                                {
                    data: null,
                    name: "alert-details",
                    className: "btn-cell",
                    orderable: false,
                    searchable: false,
                    sorting: false,
                    render: function (data, type, row, meta) {
                        data = '<div class="dropdown btn-group btn-group-sm dropright detailBtn ignore-mark">' +
                            '<button type="button" class="btn btn-alerts dropdown-toggle text-nowrap"' +
                            ' data-toggle="dropdown">Actions </button>' +
                            '<div class="dropdown-menu">' +
                            '<a class="dropdown-item modal-links" data-href="/modal-alert-comment-form.php?aid=' + row.alertid + '&page=list" href="#">Add Comment</a>' +
                                                        '<a class="dropdown-item modal-links" data-href="/modal-alert-details.php?aid=' + row.alertid + '" href="#">View Alert Details</a>' +
                            '</div></div>';
                        return data;
                    },
                },
                {
                    data: "alertid", name: "alert-id",
                    render: function (data, type, row, meta) {
                        if (type === "export") {
                            data = data.toString()
                        }
                        return data;
                    }
                },
                {data: "alertdate", name: "alert-date", className: "dateCell"},
                {data: "openedby", name: "alert-openedby"},
                {data: "category", name: "alert-category"},
                {data: "appname", name: "alert-appname"},
                {data: "poststation", name: "alert-poststation"},
                {data: "currentlocation", name: "alert-currentlocation"},
                {
                    data: "alerttext", name: "alert-description",
                    render: function (data, type, row, meta) {
                        data = row.alerttext + row.alertcomments;
                        return data;
                    }
                },
                                                                {data: "cost", name: "alert-cost"},
                {data: "priority", name: "alert-priority"},
                {data: "lastupdate", name: "alert-lastupdate", className: "dateCell"},
                {
                    data: 'withimage', name: "alert-withimage", orderable: false,
                    className: "btn-cell",
                    render: function (data, type, row, meta) {
                        if (data === 1) {
                            return '<a class="modal-links btn btn-sm btn-white m-0 px-2" data-href="/include-forms/modal-alert-images.php?id=' + row.alertid + '" href="#"><i class="icon-paper-clip-1 black-text"></i></a>'
                        } else {
                            return "";
                        }
                    }
                },
            ],
            language: {
                emptyTable: "No results. Click the VIEW SEARCH RESULTS button to search again.",
                zeroRecords: "No matches found",
                loadingRecords: '&nbsp;',
            },
            buttons: [
                {
                    extend: 'colvis',
                    text: 'View',
                },
                {
                    extend: 'collection',
                    text: 'Export',
                    buttons: [
                        {
                            extend: 'print',
                            title: ''+$departmentName+' Open Alerts as of ' + moment().format('LLL') + ' for ' + $stationName,
                            init: function (dt, node, config) {
                                $('#txtstation').on('select2:select', function (e) {
                                    let data = e.params.data;
                                    $stationName = data.text;
                                    config.title = ''+$departmentName+' Open Alerts as of ' + moment().format('LLL') + ' for ' + $stationName;
                                });
                            },
                            exportOptions: {
                                columns: ':visible:not(.no-export)',
                                stripHtml: false
                            }
                        },
                        {
                            extend: 'excelHtml5',
                            filename: 'open-alerts_' + moment().format('LLL') + '_' + $stationName,
                            title: ''+$departmentName+' Open Alerts as of ' + moment().format('LLL') + ' for ' + $stationName,
                            messageTop: 'Printed on ' + moment().format('LLL'),
                            init: function (dt, node, config) {
                                $('#txtstation').on('select2:select', function (e) {
                                    let data = e.params.data;
                                    $stationName = data.text;
                                    config.title = ''+$departmentName+' Open Alerts as of ' + moment().format('LLL') + ' for ' + $stationName;
                                    config.filename = 'open-alerts_' + moment().format('L[_]LT') + '_' + $stationName;
                                });
                            },
                            exportOptions: {
                                columns: ':visible:not(.no-export)',
                                orthogonal: 'export',
                                format: {
                                    title: function (data, row, column, node) {
                                        return ''+$departmentName+' Open Alerts as of ' + moment().format('LLL') + ' for ' + $stationName;
                                    },
                                    body: window.pstStripHtmlForExport
                                }
                            },
                            customize: function (xlsx) { //wrap text in description cell
                                var sheet = xlsx.xl.worksheets['sheet1.xml'];
                                $('row c[r^="H"]', sheet).attr('s', '55');
                            }
                        },
                        {
                            extend: 'pdfHtml5',
                            filename: 'open-alerts_' + moment().format('L[_]LT') + '_' + $stationName,
                            title: 'PSTrax Open Alerts as of ' + moment().format('LLL') + ' for ' + $stationName,
                            init: function (dt, node, config) {
                                $('#txtstation').on('select2:select', function (e) {
                                    let data = e.params.data;
                                    $stationName = data.text;
                                    config.title = 'PSTrax Open Alerts as of ' + moment().format('LLL') + ' for ' + $stationName;
                                    config.filename = 'open-alerts_' + moment().format('L[_]LT') + '_' + $stationName;
                                });
                            },
                            orientation: 'landscape',
                            pageSize: 'LEGAL',
                            exportOptions: {
                                columns: ':visible:not(.no-export)',
                                orthogonal: 'export',
                                format: {body: window.pstStripHtmlForExport}
                            },

                        },
                    ]
                },
                                {
                    text: 'Clear Filters',
                    className: 'btn-sm clrbutton',
                    action: function () {
                        resetTbl();
                        table.draw();
                    }
                },
            ],
            colReorder: {
                realtime: false
            },

            //Stuff to do when the table has finished initializing.
            initComplete: function () {
                //Show the footer below the heading
                const r = $('.dataTables_scrollFoot table tfoot');
                $('.dataTables_scrollHead table').append(r);

                //add text box inputs to column footers
                this.api().columns([".textFilter"]).every(function (colIdx) {
                    let column = this;
                    let searchbox = $('<input type="search" class="form-control form-control-sm w-100" placeholder="Search">')
                        .appendTo($(column.footer()).empty());

                    // Restore saved state values to text filters
                    let Col_IDX = table.colReorder.transpose(colIdx, "toOriginal");
                    let colSearch = table.state().columns[Col_IDX].search;
                    if (colSearch.search) {
                        $('input', this.footer()).val(colSearch.search);
                    }

                    $('input', this.footer()).on('keyup change search clear', function (ev) {
                        column
                            .search(this.value)
                            .draw();
                    });
                });
                //Add filter select inputs to column footers
                this.api().columns([".selectFilter"]).every(function () {
                    let column = this;
                    let select = $('<select class="form-control form-control-sm"><option value="">Show All</option></select>')
                        .appendTo($(column.footer()).empty())
                        .on('change', function () {
                            let val = $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex($(this).val());
                            column
                                .search(val ? '^' + val + '$' : '', true, false)
                                .draw();
                        });
                    column.data().unique().sort().each(function (d, j) {
                        if (column.search() === '^' + d + '$') {
                            select.append('<option value="' + d + '" selected="selected">' + d + '</option>')
                        } else {
                            select.append('<option value="' + d + '">' + d + '</option>')
                        }
                    });
                });
                //add filter select input to Priority column footers
                this.api().columns([".priorityFilter"]).every(function () {
                    let column = this;
                    let select = $('<select class="form-control form-control-sm"><option value="">Show All</option><option value="Urgent">Urgent</option><option value="Routine">Routine</option></select>')
                        .appendTo($(column.footer()).empty())
                        .on('change', function () {
                            if ($(this).val() === "Routine") {
                                column
                                    .search('^' + "" + '$', true, false)
                                    .draw();
                            } else {
                                let term = $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex($(this).val());
                                column
                                    .search(term ? '^' + term + '$' : '', true, false)
                                    .draw();
                            }
                        });
                });

                //Show search modal
                $searchModal.modal('show');

            }//end of InitComplete function
        });//end of Datatable definition

        //Enable #btnSubmit element when Search modal is shown (#btnSubmit is disabled so that table will initialize with an empty data set). Initialize select2 searchable dropdown
        $searchModal.on('shown.bs.modal', function (event) {
            $('#btnSubmit').prop('disabled', false);
            $('.select2').select2({
                width: "100%",
                minimumResultsForSearch: 6
            });
        });

        //Search Form submit
        $srchForm.submit(function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            resetTbl();

            table.ajax.reload(function () {
                //reset Search button and close modal
                $('#srchSubmit')
                    .prop('disabled', false)
                    .html('SEARCH');
                $searchModal.modal('hide');
            });
        });

        //Update column dropdown filters when table is re-drawn
        table.on('draw', function () {
            table.columns().indexes().each(function (idx) {
                let select = $(table.column(idx).footer()).find('select');

                if (select.val() === '') {
                    select
                        .empty()
                        .append('<option value="">Show All</option>');

                    table.column(idx, {search: 'applied'}).data().unique().sort().each(function (d, j) {
                        select.append('<option value="' + d + '">' + d + '</option>');
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        //Update column filters on column re-order
        table.on('column-reorder', function (e, settings, details) {
            //Select filters
            table.columns([".selectFilter"]).every(function () {
                let column = this;
                let select = $('<select class="form-control form-control-sm w-100"><option value="">Show All</option></select>')
                    .appendTo($(column.footer()).empty())
                    .on('change', function () {
                        let val = $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex(
                            $(this).val()
                        );
                        column
                            .search(val ? '^' + val + '$' : '', true, false)
                            .draw();
                    });

                column.data().unique().sort().each(function (d, j) {
                    if (column.search() === '^' + d + '$') {
                        select.append('<option value="' + d + '" selected="selected">' + d + '</option>')
                    } else {
                        select.append('<option value="' + d + '">' + d + '</option>')
                    }
                });
            });

            //Priority column filter
            table.columns([".priorityFilter"]).every(function () {
                let column = this;
                let select = $('<select class="form-control form-control-sm"><option value="">Show All</option><option value="Urgent">Urgent</option><option value="Routine">Routine</option></select>')
                    .appendTo($(column.footer()).empty())
                    .on('change', function () {
                        if ($(this).val() === "Routine") {
                            column
                                .search('^' + "" + '$', true, false)
                                .draw();
                        } else {
                            let term = $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex($(this).val());
                            column
                                .search(term ? '^' + term + '$' : '', true, false)
                                .draw();
                        }
                    });
            });

            //Text input filters
            table.columns([".textFilter"]).every(function (colIdx) {
                let Col_IDX = table.colReorder.transpose(colIdx, "toOriginal");
                let colSearch = table.state().columns[Col_IDX].search;

                let column = this;
                let searchbox = $('<input type="search" class="form-control form-control-sm w-100" placeholder="Search">')
                    .appendTo($(column.footer()).empty());
                if (colSearch.search) {
                    $('input', this.footer()).val(colSearch.search);
                }

                $('input', this.footer()).on('keyup change search clear', function (ev) {
                    column.search($(this).val()).draw();
                });
            });
            table.draw();
        });

        //Prevent clicking on modal buttons from deselecting row
        table.on('click', 'td.btn-cell', function () {
            table.one('user-select', function (e, dt, type, cell, originalEvent) {
                let selectedRow = $(cell.node()).parent();
                table.rows().deselect();
                selectedRow.addClass('selected');
            });

        });

        //When a modal (other than the Search Modal) is closed, get the button that was clicked. If the modal was not manually closed with the cancel or close (x) button, reload the table data
        PSTRAX.$modalContainer.on('hide.bs.modal', function (event) {
            let $activeElement = $(document.activeElement);
            if (!$activeElement.is('[data-dismiss]')) {
                table.ajax.reload(null, false);
            }
        });

    });
</script>

</body>

</html>
